name: vialchemlabs-checkout-theme-tokens
purpose: Theme matching contract for shop.vialchemlabs.net WordPress/WooCommerce checkout.

nextLayout: app/layout.tsx:6 imports app/globals.css before the v2 brand layer.
app/layout.tsx:53-58 sets html data-theme="dark" and data-accent="cyan-navy" with Geist font CSS variables.
app/layout.tsx:61-62 initializes persisted theme/accent values before interactive rendering.
brandTokens: app/v2-brand.css:7-64 defines the light token layer.
app/v2-brand.css:67-91 defines dark mode token overrides.
app/v2-brand.css:94-100 defines the default cyan-navy accent variant.
layoutPatterns: app/v2-layout.css:14-23 defines body font, background, foreground, and smoothing.
app/v2-layout.css:88-159 defines sticky nav, nav-inner, brand, nav-links, and nav-actions.
app/v2-layout.css:871-915 defines the footer grid and base row.
componentPatterns: components/v2/Shell.tsx:201-270 renders footer columns and operational base row.
components/v2/Cart.tsx:159-220 renders the existing cart order-summary aside with .card, .spec-table, .btn-accent, and .btn-ghost.

classes.body: font-family: var(--font-sans); background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5
classes.nav: position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--bg) 85%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line)
classes.navInner: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 60px; gap: 32px
classes.brand: display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px
classes.brandMark: width: 22px; height: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--fg); border-radius: 3px; display: grid; place-items: center
classes.navLinks: display: flex; gap: 24px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--fg-muted)
classes.button: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: var(--r-sm)
classes.buttonAccent: background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-fg); border-color: var(--accent)
classes.iconButton: width: 34px; height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-sm); color: var(--fg-muted)
classes.card: background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); transition: all var(--dur) var(--ease)
classes.badgeRuo: color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft)
classes.specTable: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px
classes.footer: border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 64px 0 32px; background: var(--bg-sunken)
classes.footerBase: margin-top: 64px; padding-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg-subtle); letter-spacing: 0.04em

footer.description: Research-grade peptides sold only to verified laboratories and qualified research organizations.
footer.baseLeft: © 2026 VIALCHEM LABS - RESEARCH USE ONLY - NOT FOR HUMAN OR ANIMAL USE

checkoutMatchingNotes: Use dark mode tokens by default on shop.vialchemlabs.net because app/layout.tsx:53-58 defaults html to data-theme="dark".
Use absolute https://vialchemlabs.net links for header and footer on the WordPress checkout domain.
Keep WooCommerce checkout order rows visually aligned to .spec-table and .card from app/v2-layout.css:734-762 and app/v2-layout.css:350-360.
Keep public Woo line-item names generic; real SKU/name details belong in order meta only.
